Create a photorealistic single-frame scene of visible acquisition of resource-control authority at a nighttime emergency freshwater allocation hub inside a storm-struck coastal desalination plant. One visibly adult woman has long dark brown-to-black wavy hair parted near the center, brown eyes, an oval face, natural makeup, and a neutral focused expression. She stands at the locked master console that controls the plant's potable-water allocation. At the decisive transfer moment, the outgoing controller places the brass master key and a signed emergency authorization folio into her hands. She turns the brass master key in the console's COMMAND socket while the outgoing controller steps behind a red authority line. Two technicians swivel their allocation boards toward her and await her signal. The central flow map changes from HOLD to ACTIVE, illuminated pipes route blue water toward three marked community tanks, and the main allocation dial rests under her hand. Preserve readable physical causality: the key and folio transfer, her exclusive control position, the predecessor's withdrawal, crew deference, and the water-routing consequence are all visible together.
